figure_number: Fig. 5. Behavior of a triple-resonance circuit at different frequencies.

function_summary: 40-Gb/s Amplifier and ESD Protection Circuit in 0.18-m CMOS Technology: A triple-resonance network increases the bandwidth of cascaded differential pairs by a factor of 2 3, yielding a 40-Gb/s CMOS amplifier with a gain of 15 dB and a power dissipation of 190 mW from a 2.2-V supply.
